$comment: Mycelium Framework — VibeSpace LLC — The network provides.
title: Mycelium Nutrient Request/Offer
description: A request for help or an offer of help between agent nodes. This is how the organism self-heals — nutrients flow to where they're needed most.

type.description: Whether this is a request for help or an offer to help

capabilities.description: For offers: what the agent can provide. For requests: what skills are needed.

urgency.description: How urgently the nutrient is needed

scope.description: The domain or area where help is needed/offered

description.description: Human-readable description of the need or offer

estimatedEffort.description: Rough estimate of how much work is involved (e.g., '2 hours', 'quick fix')

targetAgent.description: Specific agent this is directed at (optional — can be broadcast)

resolved.description: Whether this request/offer has been fulfilled

resolvedBy.description: Agent ID that fulfilled this request
